function mgClearGameData():

  set {_game} to mgGetCurrentGame()
  set {_world} to metadata value "MG.SK|CurrentWorld" of getDummy()

  execute console command "/sk disable MINIGAMES.SK/games/%{_game}%/init.sk"

  set {_currencies} to metadata value "MG.SK|money|currencylist" of getDummy()
  set {_moneyholderlist} to metadata value "MG.SK|money|holderlist" of getDummy()

  set {_pointsholderlist} to metadata value "MG.SK|points|holderlist" of getDummy()
  set {_pointslist} to metadata value "MG.SK|points|pointslist" of getDummy()

  loop ...{_moneyholderlist}.keySet():
    set {_player} to loop-value
    delete metadata value "MG.SK|money|%{_player}%|%{_game}%" of getDummy()

  loop ...{_pointsholderlist}.keySet():
    set {_player} to loop-value
    delete metadata value "MG.SK|points|%{_player}%|%{_game}%" of getDummy()

  delete metadata value "MG.SK|money|currencylist" of getDummy()
  delete metadata value "MG.SK|money|holderlist" of getDummy()
  delete metadata value "MG.SK|points|holderlist" of getDummy()
  delete metadata value "MG.SK|points|pointslist" of getDummy()
  delete metadata value "MG.SK|TemporaryGameData" of getDummy()
  mgSetCurrentGameStatus("")
  mgSetCurrentGame("")
  mgWipePersonalSidebarContent(null)
  mgWipeGlobalSidebarContent()
  #
  # > Wait 10 seconds before deleting the old game world.
  wait 10 seconds
  #
  # > Delete the old game world of the lobby.
  mgDeleteGameWorld({_world})

#

function mgTrainmastersHandleTrain(uuid:text,trainpart:text="other",speed:number=1):

  set {_wagonfront} to metadata value "lastwagonfront" of getMetadataBlock()

  while mgGetTemporaryGameData("status") is "ingame":
    set {_currentcoal} to mgGetTemporaryGameData("currentcoal")
    set {_maxcoal} to mgGetTemporaryGameData("maxcoal")
    set {_maxcoal} to {_maxcoal} - 1
    if {_currentcoal} >= {_maxcoal}:
      set {_multiplier} to 2
    else:
      set {_multiplier} to 1
    set {_players} to number of all players
    if {_players} is between 0 and 2:
      set {_speed} to 0.5 * {_multiplier}
    else if {_players} is between 3 and 5:
      set {_speed} to 1 * {_multiplier}
    else:
      set {_speed} to 2 * {_multiplier}
    if {_trainpart} is "locomotive":
      mgTrainmastersHandleSetBorderTrain({_wagonfront})
      mgSetTemporaryGameData("locomotive",{_wagonfront})
      mgTrainmastersUseCoal()
      set block 1 below {_wagonfront} to iron block
      mgTrainmastersUseWater()
      mgTrainmastersCreateResources()
      mgSetTemporaryGameData("respawnloc",{_wagonfront}.getLocation().clone())

      mgSetTemporaryGameData("traindistance",x-coord of {_wagonfront})
    set {_center} to vehiclesGetTmpData("vehicles.sk|center|%{_uuid}%")
    add 0.5 to y-coord of {_center}
    set {_block} to block at {_wagonfront}.getLocation()
    if {_block} is not rail:
      vehiclesKillVehicle("%{_uuid}%")
      play 20 explosion at {_wagonfront}.getLocation()
      play sound "entity.generic.explode" with volume 0.5 with pitch 0.7 at {_wagonfront}.getLocation() for all players
      set {_endit} to true
      mgTrainmastersGiveScores()
      mgTrainmastersHandler("stop")
      stop

    set {_railshape} to "%{_block}.getBlockData().getShape()%"
    loop 20 times:
	
      #
      # ADD Fix for locations on after an curve:
      # rotate the cart to the nearest correct yaw location.
	  # e.g. cart is at yaw 177, teleport it to
	  # have a yaw of 180 for proper steering.
	  # > add function called mgTrainmastersSteeringFix()
	  # to do that job seperatly and instantly.
      set {_block} to block at {_wagonfront}.getLocation()
      if {_block} is not rail:
        vehiclesKillVehicle("%{_uuid}%")
        play 20 huge explosion at {_wagonfront}.getLocation()
        play sound "entity.generic.explode" with volume 0.5 with pitch 0.7 at {_wagonfront}.getLocation() for all players
        set {_endit} to true
        mgTrainmastersGiveScores()
        mgTrainmastersHandler("stop")
        stop

chunks.title: function getCursorPos(p: player) :: location:
chunks.text:
function getCursorPos(p: player) :: location:
	set {_yaw} to yaw of {_p}
	set {_yaw} to {_yaw} - 360 if {_yaw} > 180
	set {_yaw} to {_yaw} + 360 if {_yaw} < -180
	set {_face} to "w" if {_yaw} is between -45 and 45
	set {_face} to "a" if {_yaw} is between -135 and -45
	set {_face} to "s" if {_yaw} is between 135 and 180
	set {_face} to "s" if {_yaw} is between -180 and -135
	set {_face} to "d" if {_yaw} is between 45 and 135
	set {_z} to 4 if {_face} is "w" or "a"
	set {_z} to -3 if {_face} is "s" or "d"
	set {_pz} to z of {_p} if {_face} is "w" or "s"
	set {_pz} to x of {_p} if {_face} is "a" or "d"
	set {_v} to vector in direction of {_p}
	set {_vx} to x of {_v}
	set {_vy} to y of {_v}
	set {_vz} to z of {_v}
	set {_vx} to z of {_v} if {_face} is "a"
	set {_vz} to x of {_v} if {_face} is "a"
	set {_vx} to -1 * x of {_v} if {_face} is "s"
	set {_vz} to -1 * z of {_v} if {_face} is "s"
	set {_vx} to -1 * z of {_v} if {_face} is "d"
	set {_vz} to -1 * x of {_v} if {_face} is "d"
	set {_rate} to ({_z} - {_pz}) / {_vz}
	set {_vx} to ({_vx} * {_rate} + x of {_p}) if {_face} is "w" or "s"
	set {_vx} to ({_vx} * {_rate} + z of {_p}) if {_face} is "a" or "d"
	set {_vy} to {_vy} * -1 if {_face} is "s" or "d"
	if {_p} is sneaking:
		set {_vy} to ({_vy} * {_rate} + y of {_p} + 1.4)
	else:
		set {_vy} to ({_vy} * {_rate} + y of {_p} + 1.6)
	set {_loc} to location({_vx}, {_vy}, {_z}, world "world", 0, 0) if {_face} is "w" or "s"
	set {_loc} to location({_z}, {_vy}, {_vx}, world "world", 0, 0) if {_face} is "a" or "d"
	return {_loc}

chunks.title: function getNearestTarget(loc: location, p: player) :: objects:
chunks.text:
function getNearestTarget(loc: location, p: player) :: objects:
	{-loaded} is set
	set {_playtime} to round(unix timestamp of now * 1000) - {-timer}
	set {_face} to getFace({_p})
	#还原成原始x y值
	set {_x} to x of {_loc} if {_face} is "w"
	set {_x} to -1 * z of {_loc} if {_face} is "a"
	set {_x} to -1 * x of {_loc} + 1 if {_face} is "s"
	set {_x} to z of {_loc} - 1 if {_face} is "d"
	set {_y} to y of {_loc}
	loop indices of {-onstage::*}:
		set {_index} to loop-value
		{-onstage::%{_index}%::type} is "tap" or "double"
		#边长1.5的正方形判定区
		abs({_x} - {-onstage::%{_index}%::x}) <= 1.5
		abs({_y} - {-onstage::%{_index}%::y}) <= 1.5
		#计算与判定时间的偏差
		set {_distance} to {-onstage::%{_index}%::time} - {_playtime}

local function pkg_install_dep(entry: String, depth: Integer):
    set {_entry} to trim({_entry})
    if {_entry} is not set:
        stop
    if {_entry} does not contain "://":
        stop
    if pkg_by_origin({_entry}) is set:
        stop
    set {_dep} to pkg_name({_entry})
    if {_dep} is not set:
        stop
    if pkg_installed({_dep}) is true:
        stop
    set {_installed} to pkg_install({_entry}, ({_depth} + 1))
    if {_installed} is set:
        stop
    set {_reason} to pkg_error()
    pkg_msg(console, "package dependency %{_entry}%: %{_reason}%")

# downloads, extracts and registers one package; unmet requirements leave it
# installed disabled (-<name>). returns the final name, or nothing with the
# failure reason readable via pkg_error()

chunks.title: local function pkg_install(url: String, depth: Integer) -> String:
chunks.text:
local function pkg_install(url: String, depth: Integer) -> String:
    if {_depth} > 5:
        pkg_fail("package dependencies nested too deep")
        stop
    set {_name} to pkg_name({_url})
    if {_name} is not set:
        pkg_fail("cannot derive a package name from %{_url}%")
        stop
    if pkg_installed({_name}) is true:
        pkg_fail("package %{_name}% is already installed")
        stop
    set {_zip} to pkg_zip_url({_url})
    set {_bytes} to http_get({_zip})
    if {_bytes} is not set:
        pkg_fail("download failed for %{_zip}%")
        stop
    set {_dest} to pkg_dir({_name})
    set {_sub} to pkg_sub({_url})
    dir_create({_dest})
    zip_extract({_bytes}, {_dest}, {_url})
    if all:
        {_sub} is set
        Files.list(Path.of({_dest})).findAny().isPresent() is false
    then:
        dir_delete({_dest})
        pkg_fail("archive does not contain subfolder %{_sub}%")
        stop
    set {_manifest} to manifest({_dest}, "name")
    if {_manifest} is set:
        set {_rename} to pkg_name({_manifest})
    if all:
        {_rename} is set
        {_rename} is not {_name}
    then:
        if pkg_installed({_rename}) is true:
            dir_delete({_dest})
            pkg_fail("package %{_rename}% is already installed")
            stop
        dir_rename({_dest}, pkg_dir({_rename}))
        set {_name} to {_rename}
        set {_dest} to pkg_dir({_name})
    pkg_install_deps({_dest}, {_depth})
    file_append_line("%{_dest}%/package.txt", "origin: %{_url}%")
    if pkg_missing({_dest}) is set:
        dir_rename({_dest}, pkg_disabled_dir({_name}))
    return {_name}

chunks.title: function pkg_install_report(sender: Object, url: String):
chunks.text:
function pkg_install_report(sender: Object, url: String):
    pkg_msg({_sender}, "installing from %{_url}%...")
    set {_installed} to pkg_install({_url}, 0)
    if {_installed} is not set:
        pkg_msg({_sender}, pkg_error("install failed"))
        stop
    set {_disabled} to pkg_disabled_dir({_installed})
    if dir_exists({_disabled}) is true:
        pkg_msg({_sender}, "installed %{_installed}% disabled, missing: %pkg_missing({_disabled})%")
        pkg_msg({_sender}, "resolve the requirements, then run /package enable %{_installed}%")
        stop
    pkg_msg({_sender}, "installed %{_installed}% - /sk reload scripts to apply")

# re-downloads a package from its recorded origin and replaces the
# installed copy unless it already carries the newest version. returns a
# status message, or nothing with the reason readable via pkg_error()

chunks.title: local function pkg_update(name: String) -> String:
chunks.text:
local function pkg_update(name: String) -> String:
    set {_dir} to pkg_resolve({_name})
    if {_dir} is not set:
        pkg_fail("package %{_name}% is not installed")
        stop
    set {_lines::*} to manifest_lines({_dir})
    set {_origin} to manifest_value({_lines::*}, "origin")
    if {_origin} is not set:
        pkg_fail("package %{_name}% has no origin recorded")
        stop
    set {_bytes} to http_get(pkg_zip_url({_origin}))
    if {_bytes} is not set:
        pkg_fail("download failed for %pkg_zip_url({_origin})%")
        stop
    set {_tmp} to pkg_tmp_dir({_name})
    if dir_exists({_tmp}) is true:
        dir_delete({_tmp})
    dir_create({_tmp})
    zip_extract({_bytes}, {_tmp}, {_origin})
    if Files.list(Path.of({_tmp})).findAny().isPresent() is false:
        dir_delete({_tmp})
        pkg_fail("downloaded archive from %{_origin}% is empty")
        stop
    set {_current} to manifest_value({_lines::*}, "version")
    set {_remote} to manifest({_tmp}, "version")
    if all:
        {_current} is set
        {_remote} is set
        version_at_least({_current}, {_remote}) is true
    then:
        dir_delete({_tmp})
        return "package %{_name}% is already up to date (%{_current}%)"
    set {_dest} to pkg_dir({_name})
    dir_delete({_dir})
    dir_rename({_tmp}, {_dest})
    pkg_install_deps({_dest}, 0)
    file_append_line("%{_dest}%/package.txt", "origin: %{_origin}%")
    set {_version} to ""
    if {_remote} is set:
        set {_version} to " to %{_remote}%"
    if pkg_missing({_dest}) is set:
        dir_rename({_dest}, pkg_disabled_dir({_name}))
        return "updated %{_name}%%{_version}% disabled, missing: %pkg_missing(pkg_disabled_dir({_name}))%"
    return "updated %{_name}%%{_version}% - /sk reload scripts to apply"

local function pkg_check_line(folder: String) -> String:
    set {_name} to pkg_bare({_folder})
    set {_disabled} to whether {_folder} starts with "-"
    set {_dir} to pkg_dir({_folder})
    set {_link} to pkg_link({_name}, manifest({_dir}, "origin"))
    set {_missing::*} to pkg_missing({_dir})
    if all:
        {_disabled} is true
        {_missing::*} is not set
    then:
        return "{@ok}ready{@body}: %{_link}% - requirements met, run /package enable %{_name}%"
    if {_disabled} is true:
        return "disabled: %{_link}% - missing: %{_missing::*}%"
    if {_missing::*} is set:
        return "{@error}broken{@body}: %{_link}% - missing: %{_missing::*}%"
    return "ok: %{_link}%"

chunks.title: local function pkg_outdated_line(folder: String) -> String:
chunks.text:
local function pkg_outdated_line(folder: String) -> String:
    set {_name} to pkg_bare({_folder})
    set {_dir} to pkg_dir({_folder})
    set {_lines::*} to manifest_lines({_dir})
    set {_origin} to manifest_value({_lines::*}, "origin")
    if {_origin} is not set:
        return "no origin: %{_name}% - cannot check"
    set {_link} to pkg_link({_name}, {_origin})
    set {_current} to manifest_value({_lines::*}, "version")
    set {_bytes} to http_get(pkg_zip_url({_origin}))
    if {_bytes} is not set:
        return "{@error}failed{@body}: %{_link}% - could not download from origin"
    set {_tmp} to pkg_tmp_dir({_name})
    if dir_exists({_tmp}) is true:
        dir_delete({_tmp})
    dir_create({_tmp})
    zip_extract({_bytes}, {_tmp}, {_origin})
    set {_remote} to manifest({_tmp}, "version")
    dir_delete({_tmp})
    if any:
        {_current} is not set
        {_remote} is not set
    then:
        return "unknown: %{_link}% - no version to compare"
    if version_at_least({_current}, {_remote}) is true:
        return "ok: %{_link}% (%{_current}%)"
    return "{@warn}outdated{@body}: %{_link}% (%{_current}% -> %{_remote}%)"

on TabCompleteEvent:
    set {_buffer} to event.getBuffer()
    if {_buffer} starts with "/":
        set {_buffer} to sub({_buffer}, 2)
    if {_buffer} does not start with "package ":

chunks.title: command /package [<effect: text>] [<pkg: text>]:
chunks.text:
command /package [<effect: text>] [<pkg: text>]:
    permission: console and ops
    trigger:
        if {_effect} is not set:
            pkg_usage(sender)
            stop
        if {_effect} is "list":
            set {_packages::*} to pkg_list()
            if {_packages::*} is not set:
                pkg_msg(sender, "no packages installed")
                stop
            set {_display::*} to ({_packages::*} transformed with [pkg_display(input)])
            pkg_msg(sender, "installed packages (%size of {_display::*}%): %{_display::*}%")
            stop
        if {_effect} is "check":
            set {_folders::*} to pkg_list()
            if {_folders::*} is not set:
                pkg_msg(sender, "no packages installed")
                stop
            pkg_msg(sender, "checking %size of {_folders::*}% package(s)...")
            for {_folder} in {_folders::*}:
                pkg_msg(sender, pkg_check_line({_folder}))
            stop
        if {_effect} is "outdated":
            set {_folders::*} to pkg_list()
            if {_folders::*} is not set:
                pkg_msg(sender, "no packages installed")
                stop
            pkg_msg(sender, "checking %size of {_folders::*}% package(s) for updates...")
            for {_folder} in {_folders::*}:
                pkg_msg(sender, pkg_outdated_line({_folder}))
            stop
        if {_effect} is "awesome":
            set {_link} to pkg_link("awesome-pacskage", "https://github.com/miberss/awesome-pacskage")
            pkg_msg(sender, "%{_link}% is a community list of packages to install")
            pkg_msg(sender, "find one you like, then /package install <its git url>")
            stop
        if {_effect} is "browser":
            pkg_browser(sender, {_pkg})
            stop
        if {_effect} is "selfupdate":
            pkg_selfupdate(sender)
            stop
        if {_pkg} is not set:
            pkg_usage(sender)
            stop
        set {_name} to pkg_name({_pkg})
        if {_name} is not set:
            pkg_usage(sender)
            stop
        if {_effect} is "install":
            pkg_install_report(sender, {_pkg})
            pkg_reorder(sender)
            stop
        else if {_effect} is "update":
            pkg_msg(sender, "updating %{_name}% from its origin...")
            set {_status} to pkg_update({_name})
            pkg_msg(sender, {_status} ? pkg_error("update failed"))
            pkg_reorder(sender)
            stop

options:
	# PERMISSIONS
		# whether or not the permission should be required to use
		permission-required: false
		# What permission is required to open any shulker box
		permission: bsb.use
		# Permission required by admins to unlock locked shulker boxes using the command
		permission-admin: bsb.admin
		# message to send when a user doesn't have the required permission node to unlock shulker boxes
		permission-message: &cYou do not have permission to this. &7&o(Missing node 'bsb.use')
		# message to send when a user doesn't have the required permission node to unlock shulker boxes
		permission-message-admin: &cYou do not have permission to do this.
		# how the message should be displayed to the player
		permission-message-format: actionbar # accepted entries are 'actionbar', 'title', 'message' (using any other will effectively disable this)


	# MISCELLANEOUS
		# Whether or not players should be allowed to place shulker boxes
		place-shulkers: false
		# Whether or not players open shulker boxes by shift-clicking in the inventory
		open-with-sneaking: false

	# COOLDOWN
		# Whether or not a cooldown should be applied to opening shulker boxes
		cooldown-enabled: true
		# How long a cooldown duration should last on the items
		cooldown-duration: 3 seconds
		# cooldown bypass permission to allow admins to freely open shulker boxes
		cooldown-bypass-permission: bsb.admin
		# message to send when attempting to open a shulker box while on cooldown
		# you can use '%{_remaining}%' to showcase how much longer
		cooldown-message: &cYou're currently on cooldown for another %{_remaining}%
		# Whether or not the skript should send a message when trying to open a shulker box while on cooldown
		cooldown-message-enabled: true
		# How the message should be displayed to the player
		cooldown-message-format: actionbar # accepted entries are 'actionbar', 'title', 'message' (using any other will effectively disable this)

	# SOUNDS
		# Note: setting any of the sounds to 'none' will disable the functionality
		# sound to play when a user opens a shulker box
		sounds-open: block.shulker_box.open
		# sound to play when a user closes a shulker box
		sounds-close: block.shulker_box.close
		# sound to play when a user attempts to open a locked shulker box
		sounds-locked: block.chest.locked
		# sound to play when a user attempts to open a shulker box while on cooldown
		sounds-cooldown: block.chest.locked
		# sound to the player when a user doesn't have the required permission
		sounds-permission: block.chest.locked

	# LOCKED STATE
		# message to send when attempting to open a locked shulker box
		locked-message: &cThis shulker box is currently locked, please ask an admin to unlock it!
		# Whether or not the skript should attempt to lock suspicious shulker boxes
		locked-enabled: true
		# whether or not the skript should send a message when attempting to open a locked shulker box
		locked-message-enabled: true

		locked-message-format: actionbar # accepted entries are 'actionbar', 'title', 'message' (using any other will effectively disable this)

chunks.text:
on right click with any shulker box:
	parse if {@permission-required} is true:
		if player doesn't have permission "{@permission}":
			parse if "{@permission-message-format}" is "actionbar":
				send action bar "{@permission-message}" to player
			else parse if "{@permission-message-format}" is "title":
				reset title of player
				send title "&4&lAUTHORIZATION" with subtitle "{@permission-message}" to player for 0.5 seconds with fade in 0 seconds with fadeout a second
			else parse if "{@permission-message-format}" is "message":
				send "{@permission-message}" to player
			cancel event
			stop
	stop if exact target block of player is interactable
	event-item is player's tool
	cancel event if {@place-shulkers} is false
	parse if {@open-with-sneaking} is true:
		if player is not sneaking:
			stop
	if target entity is item frame, donkey or armor stand:
		if distance between the player and location of target block <= 4:
			stop
	BSBCheckCooldown(player) is false
	BSBCheckLockedState(player, event-item) is false
	if player is holding event-item:
		set metadata "BSB;ShulkerSlot" of player to hotbar slot of player
	else:
		# Used to determine offhand slot of player
		set metadata "BSB;ShulkerSlot" of player to offhand tool of player
	set uuid tag "BlockEntityTag;PublicBukkitValues;skbee-custom;locked" of nbt of event-item to player
	BSBOpen(player, event-item)

chunks.text:
on inventory click:
	clicked slot is any shulker box
	event-inventory is inventory of player
	parse if {@permission-required} is true:
		if player doesn't have permission "{@permission}":
			parse if "{@permission-message-format}" is "actionbar":
				send action bar "{@permission-message}" to player
			else parse if "{@permission-message-format}" is "title":
				reset title of player
				send title "&4&lAUTHORIZATION" with subtitle "{@permission-message}" to player for 0.5 seconds with fadein 0 seconds with fadeout a second
			else parse if "{@permission-message-format}" is "message":
				send "{@permission-message}" to player
			cancel event
			stop
	if metadata "BSB;ShulkerSlot" of player is clicked slot:
		cancel event
		stop
	stop if click action is not right mouse button
	close player's inventory
	cancel event
	if BSBCheckCooldown(player) or BSBCheckLockedState(player, event-item) is true:
		stop
	set metadata "BSB;ShulkerSlot" of player to clicked slot
	set uuid tag "BlockEntityTag;PublicBukkitValues;skbee-custom;locked" of nbt of clicked slot to player

function getNumberFormatted(n: number) :: text: # formats a number (ex: 1,000,000 --> 1M)
	set {_data} to "Sx,21|Qi,18|Qa,15|T,12|B,9|M,6|K,3"
	loop split {_data} at "|":
		set {_s::*} to split loop-value at ","
		{_n} >= 10 ^ {_s::2} parsed as number
		set {_result} to floor({_n} / 10 ^ (({_s::2} parsed as number) - 2)) / 100

    permission:    gamealition.approved

    trigger:
        # Conditions
        if arg 1 is the player:
            message "&c*** You cannot carry yourself!"

        message "*** A carry request has been sent to &a%arg 1%&f!"

chunks.title: command /carry-accept:

    executable by: players

        # State
        set {_carrier} to {carry.%command sender%} parsed as offline player

        # Conditions
        if {_carrier} is not set:
            message "&c*** You don't have a pending carry request"
            exit trigger

        if {_carrier} is not online:
            message "&c*** %{_carrier}% is offline; carry request deleted"
            delete {carry.%command sender%}
            exit trigger

        if command sender's world != {_carrier}'s world:
            message "&c*** %{_carrier}% needs to be in the same world as you"
            exit trigger

        if distance between command sender and {_carrier} > {@max distance}:
            message "&c*** %{_carrier}% needs to be within {@max distance} blocks away from you"
            exit trigger

        # Logic
        make command sender ride {_carrier}
        delete {carry.%command sender%}
        carryNotify(command sender, {_carrier})

chunks.text:
command /prisonquest <player> <integer> <text>:
	permission: is.op
	trigger:
		if {prison.level::%uuid of arg-1%} < arg-2:
			send "&8[&ePrison&8] &7You must be &fRank %arg-2%&7 to do this quest" to arg-1
			stop
		if {prison.quest.player.stats::%uuid of arg-1%::%arg-3%} is not set:
			set {prison.quest.player.stats::%uuid of arg-1%::%arg-3%} to 1
		
		
		if arg-3 is "ironingot4":
			set {_amount} to 200
			set {_amount} to {_amount} * {prison.quest.player.stats::%uuid of arg-1%::%arg-3%} 
			if {_amount} > 2304:
				send "   &fHello" to arg-1
				wait 1 second
				send "   &You have been very helpful" to arg-1
				wait 1 second
				send "   &fI don't need anything else" to arg-1
				stop
			set {_has} to amount of iron ingots in arg-1's inventory
			if {_has} < {_amount}:
				send "   &fHello young convict" to arg-1
				wait 2 seconds
				send "   &fHow are you today" to arg-1
				wait 2 seconds	
				send "   &fGreat, great" to arg-1
				wait 2 seconds		
				send "   &fI could use a favor" to arg-1
				wait 2 seconds	
				send "   &fI really need some iron ingots" to arg-1
				wait 2 seconds	
				send "   &fCan you bring me &e%{_amount}% &firon ingots" to arg-1
				wait 2 seconds	
				send "   &fThanks" to arg-1
				wait 1 second
				if {_has} > 0:
					send "&8[&ePrison&8] &7You only have &c%{_has}%&8/&a%{_amount}%" to arg-1
			else:
				set {prison.quest.player.stats::%uuid of arg-1%::%arg-3%} to {prison.quest.player.stats::%uuid of arg-1%::%arg-3%} + 1
				send "   &fYou got the iron ingots I needed!" to arg-1
				wait 1 second
				send "   &fThank you so much" to arg-1
				remove {_amount} of iron ingots from arg-1's inventory
				wait 1 second 
				send "   &fHere take this quest point" to arg-1
				set {prison.quests.player.points::%uuid of arg-1%} to {prison.quests.player.points::%uuid of arg-1%} + 1
				wait 1 second
				send "   &fOh and a Rank 4 Key" to arg-1
				execute console command "/kp key 4 regular %arg-1% 1"
				wait 1 second
				send "   &fPleasure Doing Business!" to arg-1
		
		
		
		else if arg-3 is "coal4":
			set {_amount} to 250
			set {_amount} to {_amount} * {prison.quest.player.stats::%uuid of arg-1%::%arg-3%} 
			if {_amount} > 2304:
				send "   &fHello" to arg-1
